ctx.x: El Moro - and there was Panchito, "Flauta Magica" - was El Rubio, those those fellows. El Rubio was a flute player from - from - he played with Antonio Maria Romeu; and then when the Rubio organized a jazz band to go to one of the high-class nightclub - ah ah - Antonio Maria Romeu took the "Flauta Magica", Panchito.
What was the popular music in Cuba at that time?
